Subject: Sponsor package — activation currency + panel time availability

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. Per our notes, I attached the Ember Summit sponsor packet (v3) for your review — the key open items are:

- Activation currency (we typically allow partners to trade signage credit for lead-gen activations)
- Speaking mix: 30m panel vs 45m breakout slot availability in Track B (afternoon)
- On-site demo table positioning relative to partner lounge

Quick ask: can you confirm whether Redwood would prefer a 45m breakout (with exclusive 10-minute demo window) or a 30m panel spot plus an activation credit we can apply towards a sponsored lounge session? We can do a slot swap if you prefer the lounge activation.

Attaching the package and a brief activation rundown spreadsheet.

Attachments: Ember_Summit_Sponsor_Package_v3.pdf (pdf), Sponsor_Activation_Rundown.xlsx (xlsx)

Ellis —

Appreciate the packet. Quick internal constraints that matter for the ask:

- Our product team prefers a 45m breakout for the technical deep-dive (we want full runtime demos and a short Q&A).
- Field marketing sees more value in an experiential lounge activation for lead quality; they estimate +20% SQL conversion from a hosted demo environment.
- Budget: we have fixed deliverable credits in the committed package; trading signage credit for activation is doable but requires sign-off from Revenue Ops if the swap increases measured leads.

Proposal from Redwood: 45m breakout in Track B (afternoon) + a 20-minute dedicated demo window immediately after the session in the sponsor demo alley (non-exclusive table but priority placement). In return, we would forgo additional paid lounge hours.

Can you confirm whether Ember Summit can:
1) Reserve Track B breakout at 14:30–15:15 on Nov 16 (tentative)
2) Guarantee priority demo table positioning next to the sponsor lounge
3) Adjust the invoice to reflect the signage credit swap (we'll need a line-item for activation credit)

Looping in Marissa/Tessa to confirm ops and lead capture plan.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel

Monica/Tessa —

Notes from ops:
- We can staff a 20-minute demo window after a 45m session but need a dedicated ethernet line and a BYO router (venue charges for switches are steep). Budget for onsite connectivity is ~$1,200.
- Lead capture: recommend using our QR + QR-to-CRM flow to avoid badge-swipe fees; need a Converge-approved Wi‑Fi SSID and the exhibitor API key (Ellis, can you share?).
- Creative/Branding: if we swap signage credit, we want a 1.5x horizontal banner placement above the demo alley entrance rather than standard isle signage. That's our primary ask for visibility.

Also, we should get DocuSign-ready language that clearly lists the swap (signage credit -> activation credit) and the time/site commitments.

— Marissa

Thanks for the clarity. All good news:

1) Track B breakout at 14:30–15:15 on Nov 16 is available; we will tentatively hold it for Redwood pending signed amendment.
2) Priority demo table positioning: we can commit to the table immediately adjacent to the sponsor lounge (Table A3) and will mark it as priority.
3) Signage credit swap: we can reassign 50% of the standard signage collateral value to an activation credit; we'll add an addendum with the exact invoice adjustment.

Naveen from our ops partner (Atelier) is cc'd — he will handle the tech runsheet and connectivity options; he can provide ethernet pricing and onsite tech support quotes.

I'll draft a short addendum for sign-off (DocuSign) that lists: reserved time, demo table id, new banner placement spec, and invoice line-item. Expect a draft by EOD tomorrow.

— Ellis
